one_liner.zh: 每个组件都是时间的纯函数：一套有语法的动效库，可跳转、可逐帧、循环闭合零像素差，含金融 UI 组件族。
one_liner.en: Every component is a pure function of time — a motion library with real grammar: seekable, frame-exact, loop-closing to zero pixel diff, with a finance UI family.

problem.zh: 动效 demo 满地都是，但它们是「演给人看的」，不是「可依赖的」：无法任意跳转、无法逐帧控制、循环点会抖。同时，金融/交易界面的展示组件（报价、杠杆、回放）在通用组件库里长期缺位。
problem.en: Motion demos are everywhere, but they perform rather than compute: no seeking, no frame accuracy, visible loop seams. Finance UI components (quotes, leverage, replay) are missing from generic libraries.

scenarios.zh: 产品宣传视频需要无缝循环的组件动画
scenarios.en: Product promo videos need seamless component loops
scenarios.outcome_zh: 20s 闭环，t=0 与 t=20 逐像素比对 max diff = 0（render.py loop 可复验）
scenarios.outcome_en: 20s closed loop; t=0 vs t=20 pixel comparison max diff = 0 (re-runnable via render.py loop)

scenarios.zh: 金融界面需要守配色纪律的动效组件
scenarios.en: Finance UI needs motion components with color discipline
scenarios.outcome_zh: 蓝=中性/操作、绿=涨、红=跌/风险，11 个 Quote Morph 组件已交付
scenarios.outcome_en: Blue=neutral/action, green=up, red=down/risk; 11 Quote Morph components delivered

scenarios.zh: 动画需要任意时刻可求值（演示、拖拽回放、Lottie 替代）
scenarios.en: Animation must be evaluable at any instant (demos, scrubbing, Lottie alternative)
scenarios.outcome_zh: seek(t) 是纯函数，无 CSS transition、无定时器、无帧间状态
scenarios.outcome_en: seek(t) is a pure function: no CSS transitions, no timers, no inter-frame state

architecture.summary_zh: spec 驱动引擎：加一个组件族 = 加一份 spec，不动核心。构建时把引擎与字体内联成单文件 HTML；渲染时 Playwright 逐子帧截图直灌 ffmpeg tmix 动态模糊。
architecture.summary_en: Spec-driven engine: a new component family is a new spec, not a core change. Build inlines engine+fonts into single-file HTML; render pipes Playwright sub-frames straight into ffmpeg tmix motion blur.

modules.role_zh: 引擎：弹簧闭式解 / 时间轴 / 状态渲染器
modules.role_en: Engine: closed-form springs / timeline / state renderers

modules.role_zh: 4 个模板：循环动画 / 组件总览 / 单组件渲染 / 视频总览
modules.role_en: 4 templates: loop, library, per-component, video index

modules.role_zh: 字体与引擎内联 → dist/*.html 单文件零外链
Playwright 逐帧渲染 + ffmpeg tmix，rgb24 直灌不落盘
modules.role_en: Playwright frame rendering + ffmpeg tmix, rawvideo piped
